edges.reason: msg.sender is the source account debited in transfer.
msg.sender provides the allowance owner and balance spender in transferFrom.
msg.sender is credited with purchased tokens in buy.
msg.sender is the balance holder burned by convertMainchainGPX.
msg.sender is used to index the balances mapping.
msg.sender is used to index the allowed mapping.
tokenPool address indexes balances for pool debits and credits.
TOTAL_SUPPLY is credited to balances[tokenPool] at construction.
buyRate determines the token amount minted by buy.
paused gates buy through the whenNotPaused modifier.
pause writes the paused flag.
unpause writes the paused flag.
msg.sender is the subject of the isOwner authorization check used by anyOwner.
msg.sender is passed as currentUser to the multi-owner confirmation routine.
isOwner iterates m_owners to authorize the caller.
checkAndConfirm reads and writes m_pendings to accumulate confirmations.
checkAndConfirm compares confirmTotal against m_multiRequires.
checkAndConfirm bounds its loops with m_numOwners.
The payable fallback forwards received value into buy().
pause reaches checkAndConfirm through the mostOwner modifier.
unpause reaches checkAndConfirm through the mostOwner modifier.
setBuyRate reaches checkAndConfirm through the mostOwner modifier.
mallocBudget reaches checkAndConfirm through the mostOwner modifier.
execute reaches checkAndConfirm through the mostOwner modifier.
execute performs an outbound value transfer to a caller-supplied address before returning.
buy computes msg.value.mul(buyRate) through SafeMath.mul.
transfer subtracts the sent value from the sender balance via SafeMath.sub.
transfer adds the sent value to the recipient balance via SafeMath.add.
transferFrom subtracts from source balance and allowance via SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom adds to the recipient balance via SafeMath.add.
mallocBudget subtracts allocated value from the pool via SafeMath.sub.
mallocBudget adds allocated value to the admin via SafeMath.add.
convertMainchainGPX adds the burned amount back into tokenPool via SafeMath.add.
increaseApproval adds to the allowance via SafeMath.add.
decreaseApproval subtracts from the allowance via SafeMath.sub.
checkAndConfirm computes the confirmation fingerprint with unchecked exponent and bitwise OR.
setBuyRate builds its operation key from keccak256(msg.data).
mallocBudget builds its operation key from keccak256(msg.data).
execute builds its operation key from keccak256(msg.data).
pause builds its operation key from keccak256(msg.data).
unpause builds its operation key from keccak256(msg.data).
destinationAccount flows into the Converted event payload.
extra flows into the Converted event payload.
_value is the amount validated against the sender balance in transfer.
_to is the recipient validated and credited in transfer.
_from is the source address validated in transferFrom.
_spender is the address granted allowance in approve.
newBuyRate is written into the buyRate state variable.
_admin receives the allocated budget tokens.
_to is the recipient of the ether withdrawal in execute.
_extra is included in the Withdraw event.
_value is the ether amount transferred in execute.
currentUser is matched against the owner set in checkAndConfirm.
operation keys the pending confirmation bitmap in checkAndConfirm.
_multiOwners populates the m_owners array in the constructor.
_multiRequires is validated and stored as m_multiRequires.
tokens is debited from balances[tokenPool] and credited to the buyer.
amount is the caller balance zeroed and added back to the pool balance.
oldValue is the previous allowance used in the decrease branch.
newBitFinger is stored back into m_pendings when the threshold is not reached.
confirmTotal is compared against m_multiRequires and emitted.
ownerIndex selects the confirming owner inside m_owners.

normalization_plan.reason: destinationAccount is a transient parameter of convertMainchainGPX and collapses into that function node.
extra is only forwarded to the Converted event by convertMainchainGPX.
_value is the amount argument consumed by transfer.
_to is the recipient argument consumed by transfer.
_from is the source argument consumed by transferFrom.
_spender is the spender argument consumed by approve.
newBuyRate is the value argument written by setBuyRate.
_admin is the recipient argument consumed by mallocBudget.
_to is the recipient argument of the external transfer in execute.
_extra is only used in the Withdraw event emitted by execute.
_value is the ether amount transferred by execute.
currentUser is the confirming-owner argument processed by checkAndConfirm.
operation is the confirmation key processed by checkAndConfirm.
_multiOwners is only consumed by the MultiOwnable constructor.
_multiRequires is only consumed by the MultiOwnable constructor.
tokens is a temporary computed inside buy before being credited.
amount is a temporary caching the caller balance inside convertMainchainGPX.
oldValue is a temporary caching the prior allowance inside decreaseApproval.
newBitFinger is a temporary computed and stored inside checkAndConfirm.
confirmTotal is a temporary tally computed inside checkAndConfirm.
ownerIndex is a temporary owner lookup computed inside checkAndConfirm.
